newsitem.title: USA: Arco restarted Calif diesel unit Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Arco restarted Calif diesel unit Saturday.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO) restarted a hydrocracker over the weekend after workers repaired a leak in the diesel-making unit, a company spokesman said on Monday.
"It came back up Saturday morning," the spokesman said. "We are probably at full rate right now."
The leak caused the 4,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) unit to make off-spec diesel fuel last week, the company said.
California CARB-grade prices rose two cents last Tuesday, after ARCO bought 60,000 bpd of diesel to cover the unit's lost output, traders said.
